CLASS zcl_mcp_badi_real DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mcp_badi_real IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA lo_tool TYPE REF TO if_enh_tool.
    DATA lo_impl TYPE REF TO cl_enh_tool_badi_impl.
    DATA lv_hits TYPE i.
    SELECT DISTINCT enhname FROM enhheader UP TO 600 ROWS INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_enh).
    out->write( |CANDIDATES { lines( lt_enh ) }| ).
    LOOP AT lt_enh INTO DATA(ls_enh).
      IF lv_hits >= 3. EXIT. ENDIF.
      TRY.
          lo_tool = cl_enh_factory=>get_enhancement( enhancement_id = ls_enh-enhname run_dark = abap_true ).
          IF lo_tool->get_tool( ) <> cl_enh_tool_badi_impl=>tooltype. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
          lo_impl ?= lo_tool.
          LOOP AT lo_impl->get_implementations( ) INTO DATA(ls_i).
            IF lines( ls_i-filter_values ) = 0. CONTINUE. ENDIF.
            lv_hits = lv_hits + 1.
            out->write( |=== { ls_enh-enhname } / { ls_i-badi_name } / { ls_i-impl_name }| ).
            LOOP AT ls_i-filter_root INTO DATA(ls_r).
              out->write( |  ROOT root={ ls_r-root } ids={ lines( ls_r-filters ) }| ).
              LOOP AT ls_r-filters INTO DATA(lv_id).
                out->write( |    rootfilter id={ lv_id }| ).
              ENDLOOP.
            ENDLOOP.
            LOOP AT ls_i-filter_tree INTO DATA(ls_t).
              out->write( |  TREE parent={ ls_t-parent } child={ ls_t-child }| ).
            ENDLOOP.
            LOOP AT ls_i-filter_values INTO DATA(ls_v).
              out->write( |  VALUE id={ ls_v-id } name=[{ ls_v-filter_name }] type=[{ ls_v-filter_type }] cmp=[{ ls_v-compare }] c1=[{ ls_v-filter_char_value1 }] c2=[{ ls_v-filter_char_value2 }] g1=[{ ls_v-filter_general_value1 }] s1=[{ ls_v-filter_string_value1 }] len={ ls_v-check_length } ctype=[{ ls_v-check_type }] isdom=[{ ls_v-check_type_is_dom }]| ).
            ENDLOOP.
            LOOP AT ls_i-filters INTO DATA(ls_f).
              out->write( |  FLAT name=[{ ls_f-filter_name }] cmp=[{ ls_f-compare }] c1=[{ ls_f-filter_char_value1 }] conj={ ls_f-conj_idx } disj={ ls_f-disj_idx }| ).
            ENDLOOP.
            EXIT.
          ENDLOOP.
        CATCH cx_root.
          CONTINUE.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.
    out->write( |HITS { lv_hits }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
